title: Month-over-Month Revenue Growth Rate
description:
Calculate the month-over-month revenue growth rate percentage for each month.

**Table: monthly_revenue** — `month`, `revenue`

Output columns: `month`, `revenue`, `mom_growth_pct`. Order by `month`.
solution_sql: SELECT month, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month

test_cases.description: 8 months; Jan has NULL growth; Feb-Aug show MoM growth rates with 2 negative months (Mar and Jun)

hints: MoM growth % = 100 * (current_revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue; negative values mean the revenue declined.
The first month (Jan) will always have NULL for mom_growth_pct since there is no prior period.
explanation: LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) fetches the previous month's revenue. Feb growth: (88k-80k)/80k = +10.00%. Mar: (82k-88k)/88k = -6.82% (decline). Apr: (95k-82k)/82k = +15.85%. May: (110k-95k)/95k = +15.79%. Jun: -4.55% (decline). Jul: +12.38%. Aug: +10.17%. 8 rows total.
